seasonRead.headline: 2021–22: Shot creation drives the first full-season attack
paragraphs: In the first 82-game schedule after two shortened seasons, Shot-Creation Scorer becomes the central offensive identity. Shots, expected goals, rebounds and continued zone time all point to players who manufacture attempts rather than wait for one perfect look.

Two-Way Skill Scorer adds takeaways and playmaking to that offense, while High-Touch Risk/Reward Scorer carries more high-touch variance. The hockey tradeoff is familiar: volume creates pressure, but another player still has to recover the puck and make the next chance better.

seasonRead.headline: 2021–22: One broad defense label; one clearly active counterweight
paragraphs: The consolidated profile map is unusually compressed around Defensive Role Defenseman. Several distinct statistical groups collapse into that one name, so its share describes a broad family of roles rather than one quiet, low-creation tactical job.

Puck-Pressure Transition Defenseman is the useful counterweight, carrying more takeaways and production from the back end. A coach can concentrate that activation on selected pairs without asking the entire blue line to play at the same risk level.
